verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com that indexes the Mesh documentation guides. The cited doc pages are served as raw .md URLs (e.g. overview.md, webhooks.md), so an agent can ingest the docs directly. The .md.md 404 is just a doubled-extension probe and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: an llms-full.txt or explicit agent-oriented guidance in the docs, OpenAPI at a machine-discoverable standard path, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
